name: Maharashtra Public Works Department
summary: The state department that builds and maintains Maharashtra's state highways, major district roads and bridges.
about: Maharashtra's Public Works Department maintains the state highways and district roads outside the big tolled corridors, which belong to the Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation. Its network has to cope with the Western Ghats — steep ghat sections and heavy monsoon damage are a permanent part of the job.
facts: Responsible for Maharashtra's state highways and major district roads.
Also looks after most state-owned bridges and government buildings.
National highways in the state are not its responsibility — those belong to NHAI, NHIDCL or the state's national highway wing.
